title: Glass Morphism UI Icon
description: Modern glassmorphism style UI icon for SaaS dashboards, iOS apps, and tech landing pages. Translucent, blurred, premium.

prompt.main: glass morphism style app icon for a music player, translucent frosted glass square with rounded corners, soft pastel gradient background in pink to purple, subtle white border, soft drop shadow, modern UI design, dribbble featured --ar 1:1 --v 6.1 --s 500

explained.why: Square icons for iOS/Android and dashboard UI.
Mid stylize for clean modern look. Higher stylize adds unwanted decoration.

tutorial.intro: Glassmorphism = "frosted glass" + "soft gradient" + "rounded corners" + "subtle shadow". Skip any one and the illusion breaks.
steps: Material: translucent frosted glass square with rounded corners 鈥?material + shape.
Background: soft pastel gradient background in pink to purple 鈥?gradient direction matters.
Edge: subtle white border 鈥?the "edge highlight" is what sells the glass.
Depth: soft drop shadow 鈥?without shadow, glass floats awkwardly.
Reference: modern UI design, dribbble featured 鈥?Dribbble reference primes the right visual code.
tutorial.tips: Without "soft drop shadow", the glass icon looks pasted. Without "subtle white border", the glass looks flat.

faq.q: Why does my glass icon look flat?
faq.a: You forgot "subtle white border" or "soft drop shadow". The edge highlight is non-negotiable for glassmorphism.
Soft pastel gradients: pink to purple, blue to cyan, mint to sky. Avoid saturated pure colors.

faq.q: How to make icons look premium?
faq.a: Add "dribbble featured" or "behance curated" to your prompt. MJ treats these as quality signals.
